high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a selfie in front of a large mirror mounted on a wall. The individual is wearing a dark-colored oversized t-shirt with some text or design on the left side of the chest. They have long, dark hair that falls over their shoulders. The setting appears to be a luxurious bathroom, as indicated by the high-end fixtures and materials. The mirror has a gold frame, and the sink below it is white with a modern faucet. The countertop is black, and there is a glimpse of a white towel or cloth on the right side of the sink.
